description: Consumer Affairs Authority - The Consumer Affairs Authority here by rescind Direction No. 89 and 90 Published in Gazette Extra Ordinary No. 2327/35 dated 12th April, 2023
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice where the Consumer Affairs Authority is rescinding previous directions (No. 89 & 90) under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It involves regulatory action and the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation, which falls squarely within the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a government authority and its chairman, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
